# Clinical record

Snapshot Revision 80. Last diary entry 2026-11-23.

For a first visit, start with the patient summary. For a specific question, read the relevant dated week or course dossier and retain the source IDs when citing observations.

- [Patient summary](exports/patient-summary.md) — Short introduction with dated evidence.
- [Clinical overview](exports/clinical-overview.md) — Selected milestones with source references.
- [Full chronology](exports/full-chronology.md) — Treatment actions, baseline changes, tests and other dated events.
- [Latest diary week](weeks/2026-11-23.md) — Includes the last diary entry on 2026-11-23. For another date use the Monday of its week in the filename.
- [Calendar intervals](exports/timetable-spans.json) — Timed spans with recorded or inferred boundaries and links to the underlying records.
- [Current stack](exports/current-stack.json) — Reported doses, schedules and the date of the review.
- [Recent diet](exports/current-diet.json) — Meals documented in the 30 calendar days ending at the latest diary date, with dated sources.
- [Bowel frequency](exports/bowel-frequency.json) — Recorded movements, days with coverage and rate denominators.
- [Symptom patterns and sensory descriptions](symptom-patterns.html) — Recurring PEM presentations and subjective sensations, organized by symptoms, locations and dates.
- [Symptom quality links · structured](exports/symptom-qualifiers.json) — Stable source occurrence IDs, region, sensory quality, review confidence and compatible identity links.
- [PEM subtype and PENE historical-cluster evidence](exports/symptom-phenotypes.json) — Preserves retrospective reports without inventing dated crashes.
- [PEM-like state and phases](pem-patterns.html) — Patient-described warning, malaise, poisoned quality, severe crashes and independent sensory markers.
- [PEM-like state · structured](exports/pem-state-markers.json) — Source-linked state-phase/quality markers, no inferred transitions or causality.
- [PEM state reading guide](exports/pem-state-notes.md) — Compact phase/quality definitions with supporting source records.
- [Symptom histories](exports/symptom-priorities.json) — Onset, recovery, current status, occurrence pattern, triggers, functional impact and supporting evidence.
- [Reviewed symptom episode groups](exports/symptom-episodes.md) — Source-linked patterns following NADH, overlapping bezisterim and probiotic trials, and rapamycin; timing is not proof of causation.
- [Symptom episode groups · structured](exports/symptom-episodes.json) — Stable symptom and intervention IDs, relationship labels, and supporting records.
- [Editable symptom list](exports/symptom-list.md) — One bullet per current identity, with occurrence and dates.
- [Symptom review answers](exports/symptom-review.md) — Dated diary examples, distinctions and decisions from the annotated symptom review.
- [Treatment types and adverse responses](exports/treatment-responses.json) — Reviewed worsening, source and attribution for each intervention.
- [Daily scores](exports/daily-scores.json) — Dated patient ratings.
- [Laboratory results](exports/biomarkers.json) — Biomarker identities, individual results and available sample details.
- [Symptoms](symptoms.html) — Patient descriptions and links to dated occurrences.
- [Interventions](interventions.html) — Products, course histories and reported effects. Each course has a Markdown dossier.
- [October 2024 NADH episode](courses/44b32159-76c8-55fe-ac48-80f6c4554167.json) — Course-specific evidence before, during and after the recorded administrations.

All paths are relative to this file. For a private or offline copy, upload the relevant Markdown or JSON files to the recipient’s chosen tool.

When accounts disagree on dates, consult the reconciliation and reviewed course. Original accounts are retained alongside the corrections.

Reported effects and temporal associations retain their original attribution. A missing observation does not establish that a symptom was absent. Estimated meal lengths and symptom endpoints mark timetable conventions. They do not establish when eating finished or symptoms resolved.
